items.title: The Longevity Playbook with Rhonda Patrick
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, Gary O'Reilly, Rhonda Patrick
items.content:
How do you live longer and better? Neil deGrasse Tyson and co-hosts Chuck Nice and Gary O’Reilly sit down with biomedical scientist Rhonda Patrick to explore healthspan, fad diets, and how to exercise for longevity.

items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Jordan Klepper
items.content:

items.title: The Habitable Worlds Observatory with Evgenya Shkolnik
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Matt Kirshen, Evgenya Shkolnik
items.content:
Are there habitable worlds that look nothing like Earth? Neil deGrasse Tyson and comic co-host Matt Kirshen discuss NASA’s Habitable Worlds Observatory and its eventual search for life beyond our solar system with astrophysicist Evgenya Shkolnik.

items.title: The Game Theory of AI with Aza Raskin
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Gary O'Reilly, Chuck Nice, Aza Raskin

items.title: Bose-Einstein Condensate, Collisions, The Physics of Fire –TYTYK
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice
items.content:

items.title: In Theory with Janna Levin
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Janna Levin
items.content:
If something is possible, has the universe tried it? Are all physical possibilities inevitable? Neil deGrasse Tyson sits down with theoretical astrophysicist Janna Levin to launch “In Theory,” a new StarTalk series celebrating the weird, wacky theories of the universe and the theorists who chase them. Out on YouTube October 29, 2026!
